```{r}
# loading libraries
library(dplyr)
library(DataExplorer)
library(glmnet)
```

```{r}
source("util.R")

book26 = read.csv("data/book26.csv", header = T)
book26 = set_types(book26)

claims26 = book26 %>%
  mutate(
    ExcessChosen = factor(ExcessChosen, levels = c(500, 750, 1000))
  )
severity26 = book26 %>%
  filter(ClaimNb > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    AvgSeverity = ClaimAmount / ClaimNb,
    ExcessChosen = factor(ExcessChosen, levels = c(500, 750, 1000))
  )
```

```{r}
# Fit a simple GLM based on domain knowledge and legacy factors.

# Covariates:
# - Zone, VehicleType, Age, NCD, VehValue
# 
# ClaimNb ~ DriverAge + YearsLicensed + VehAge + VehValue +
#   VehicleType + RiskZone + Density + AnnualKms +
#   ExcessChosen + GaragingLocation + VehicleUse +
#   NCDLevel + TenureYears + MultiPolicyFlag +
#   PaymentFrequency + offset(log(Exposure))

freq_formula_all = ClaimNb ~ DriverAge + YearsLicensed + VehAge + VehValue +
  VehicleType + RiskZone + Density + AnnualKms +
  ExcessChosen + GaragingLocation + VehicleUse +
  NCDLevel + TenureYears + MultiPolicyFlag +
  PaymentFrequency + offset(log(Exposure))

sev_formula_all = AvgSeverity ~ DriverAge + YearsLicensed + VehAge + VehValue +
  VehicleType + RiskZone + Density + AnnualKms +
  ExcessChosen + GaragingLocation + VehicleUse +
  NCDLevel + TenureYears + MultiPolicyFlag +
  PaymentFrequency

freq_model_all = glm(freq_formula_all, data = claims26, family = poisson(link = "log"))
summary(freq_model_all)
# DriverAge / YearsLicensed + VehicleType (Ute) + RiskZone + AnnualKms + Garaging Location + NCDLevel / TenureYears as the risk drivers
# ExcessChosen and MultiPolicyFlag removed as they are not inherent risk drivers
# Exposure was removed as it doesnt have predictive value and does not appear in future pricing books

sev_model_all = glm(sev_formula_all, data = severity26, family = Gamma(link = "log"))
summary(sev_model_all)
# VehValue + VehicleType + RiskZone + NCDLevel / TenureYears
# ExcessChosen was removed

freq_formula_explainable = ClaimNb ~ DriverAge + VehicleType + RiskZone + AnnualKms + GaragingLocation + NCDLevel

sev_formula_explainable = AvgSeverity ~ VehValue + VehicleType + RiskZone + NCDLevel

freq_model = glm(freq_formula_explainable, data = claims26, family = poisson(link = "log"))
summary(freq_model)

sev_model = glm(sev_formula_explainable, data = severity26, family = Gamma(link = "log"))
summary(sev_model)
```

```{r}
# Generate a technical price for book27
book27 = read.csv("data/renewal_book_2027.csv", header = T)
book27 = set_types(book27)

book27 = book27 %>%
  mutate(
    PredictedClaimNb = predict(freq_model, newdata = ., type = "response"),
    PredictedAvgSev = predict(sev_model, newdata = ., type = "response"),
    TechnicalPrice = PredictedClaimNb * PredictedAvgSev
  )
```

```{r}
source("discount.R")
FixedCost = 85
VariableExpenseRate = 0.1
ProfitMargin = 0.08


book27 = book27 %>%
  mutate(
    LoadedPremium = (TechnicalPrice + FixedCost) / (1 - VariableExpenseRate - ProfitMargin),
    AdditiveDiscountFactor = 1 - (get_NoClaimDiscount(NCDLevel) + get_LoyaltyDiscount(TenureYears) + get_MultiPolicyDiscount(MultiPolicyFlag)),
    MultiplicativeDiscountFactor = (1 - get_NoClaimDiscount(NCDLevel)) *
                                   (1 - get_LoyaltyDiscount(TenureYears)) *
                                   (1 - get_MultiPolicyDiscount(MultiPolicyFlag)),
    AdditiveDiscountPremium = AdditiveDiscountFactor * LoadedPremium,
    MultiplicativeDiscountPremium = MultiplicativeDiscountFactor * LoadedPremium
  )

# We will generate 1 premium based on additive discount and one on multiplicative discounts (they are commutative so discounts can be in any order)
# They will be unbounded and then we will decide the cap and collar.
```
